changes.what: Audit fix: markPaid could unlock a bigger game with a smaller size's payment if the owner raised the limit between the size check and the write. Every write of markPaid now only happens while the game is still unpaid, open and at the limit the size was worked out from (cap=?); otherwise it refuses for certain and writes nothing.

Invite by ID only. The list takes one ID per person (letters and digits; A-1101, A 1101 and A/1101 are the same). No names or mobile numbers are asked, stored or shown for guests. A person not on the list waits for the organizer's yes or no. The join page has one ID box and a nickname box.
